1779	    def _recv_kv_payload(self, group: Any, src: int, device: torch.device) -> dict[str, Any] | None:
1780	        """Inverse of :meth:`_send_kv_payload`."""
1781	        size_or_obj = group.recv_object(src)
1782	        if not isinstance(size_or_obj, int):
1783	            return size_or_obj
1784	        combined = group.recv(torch.Size([size_or_obj]), torch.uint8, src)
1785	        combined = combined.to(device)
1786	        return self._unpack_kv_payload(combined)
1787	
1788	    def _tp_local_receive_consensus(self, req: Any, received: bool) -> bool:
1789	        """Identical-KV-state verdict across pure-TP ranks (LOCAL role).
1790	
1791	        In pure TP every rank fetches its own KV shard with an independent
1792	        timeout and ``distribute_kv_cache`` is a no-op, so a single rank's
1793	        silent miss sends only that rank into the pipeline's no-KV prefill —
1794	        it then enters TP collectives its peers never join, and the NCCL
1795	        watchdog kills the worker (#5627). Each rank reports a signature of
1796	        its applied KV state — the primary-receive flag plus the set of
1797	        applied payload roles, so partially-received CFG companion KV
1798	        (``cfg_text``/``cfg_img``) diverging between ranks is caught too. If
1799	        the signatures differ, every rank drops its KV so all take the same
1800	        fallback path together; identical-but-partial state is kept, since
1801	        symmetric absence is consistent (e.g. Bagel's empty unconditional
1802	        branch).
1803	
1804	        The exchange runs over the stage's tensor-parallel group only: those
1805	        are the ranks executing this request in lockstep. ``world`` would
1806	        also contain DP replicas / PP stages working on different requests —
1807	        mixing their flags corrupts the verdict, and a replica skipping the
1808	        exchange (dummy request) while another enters it would deadlock.
1809	        Within the TP group the skip guards below depend only on topology,
1810	        config, and the request id — identical on every TP rank — so ranks
1811	        always agree on whether the exchange happens.
1812	        """
1813	        pt = self.topo_config
1814	        group = pt.tp_group
1815	        if not (pt.is_local and pt.tp_active) or group is None or pt.tp_size <= 1:
1816	            return received
1817	        if not self.config.need_recv_cache:
1818	            return received
1819	        request_id = self._resolve_request_id(req)
1820	        if request_id is None or OmniDiffusionRequest.is_dummy_run_request_id(request_id):
1821	            return received
1822	
1823	        signature = (bool(received), tuple(sorted(self._collect_request_kv_payload(req))))
1824	        if group.rank_in_group == 0:
1825	            signatures = [signature]
1826	            signatures.extend(group.recv_object(src=src) for src in range(1, pt.tp_size))
1827	            consistent = all(sig == signature for sig in signatures)
1828	            group.broadcast_object(consistent, src=0)
1829	        else:
1830	            group.send_object(signature, dst=0)
1831	            consistent = bool(group.broadcast_object(None, src=0))
1832	
1833	        if not consistent:
1834	            logger.warning(
1835	                "KV state for %s diverged across TP ranks (this rank: received=%s, roles=%s); "
1836	                "dropping KV on every rank so all take the no-KV fallback together "
1837	                "instead of desyncing TP collectives",
1838	                request_id,
1839	                signature[0],
1840	                list(signature[1]),
1841	            )
1842	            self._clear_request_kv_payload(req)
1843	            return False
1844	        return received
1845	
1846	    def receive_multi_kv_cache_distributed(
1847	        self,
1848	        req: Any,
1849	        cfg_kv_collect_func: Callable | None = None,
1850	        target_device: torch.device | None = None,
1851	    ) -> bool:
1852	        """Synchronous receive: fetch → distribute → apply (FOLLOWER skips fetch)."""
1853	        received = False
1854	        if not self.topo_config.is_follower:
1855	            received = self.receive_multi_kv_cache(req, cfg_kv_collect_func, target_device)
1856	        received = self._tp_local_receive_consensus(req, received)
1857	        kv_payload = self.distribute_kv_cache(req, target_device, received=received)
1858	        if kv_payload is not None:
1859	            self._apply_request_kv_payload(req, kv_payload, target_device)
1860	        return received or kv_payload is not None
1861	
1862	    def consume_and_distribute_kv_cache(self, req: Any, target_device: torch.device | None = None) -> bool:
1863	        """Consume prefetched KV → apply → distribute; sync-receive on miss (no retry on consume-error)."""
1864	        received = False
1865	        payload_consumed = False
1866	        if self._async_prefetch and not self.topo_config.is_follower:
1867	            try:
1868	                data, _ = self.consume_prefetched_kv(req)
1869	                if data is not None:
1870	                    self._record_stream_for_prefetched(data)
1871	                    self.apply_kv_cache_to_request(req, data)
1872	                    received = True
1873	            except KVPrefetchConsumeError:
1874	                logger.error(
1875	                    "KV prefetch consumed payload for %s but post-get failed; request cannot recover",
1876	                    self._resolve_request_id(req),
1877	                )
1878	                payload_consumed = True
1879	        # Only fall back to sync receive on miss, not when payload was
1880	        # already consumed from the connector (sync receive would block
1881	        # until timeout as the data is gone).
1882	        if not received and not self.topo_config.is_follower and not payload_consumed:
1883	            logger.debug("KV prefetch miss for %s; falling back to sync receive", self._resolve_request_id(req))
1884	            received = self.receive_multi_kv_cache(req, None, target_device)
1885	        received = self._tp_local_receive_consensus(req, received)
1886	        kv_payload = self.distribute_kv_cache(req, target_device, received=received)
1887	        if kv_payload is not None:
1888	            self._apply_request_kv_payload(req, kv_payload, target_device)
1889	        return received or kv_payload is not None
1890	
1891	    def _cfg_scatter(
1892	        self,
1893	        group: Any,
1894	        payloads: list[Any],
1895	        cfg_size: int,
1896	        device: torch.device | None,
1897	        request_id: str | None = None,
1898	    ) -> None:
1899	        """Scatter one payload per CFG follower."""
1900	        for dst in range(1, cfg_size):
1901	            try:
1902	                self._send_kv_payload(group, payloads[dst], dst, device)
1903	            except Exception:
1904	                logger.warning("CFG scatter to rank %d failed for %s; that rank runs without KV", dst, request_id)
1905	                continue
1906	
1907	    def distribute_kv_cache(
1908	        self, req: Any, target_device: torch.device | None = None, *, received: bool = False
1909	    ) -> dict[str, Any] | None:
1910	        """Distribute KV LEADER→FOLLOWER. No-op for LOCAL/pure TP."""
1911	        pt = self.topo_config
1912	
1913	        # LOCAL: no distribution.
1914	        if pt.is_local:
1915	            return None
1916	
1917	        device = target_device if target_device is not None else torch.device("cpu")
1918	        # TP + CFG/SP
1919	        if pt.tp_active and (pt.cfg_active or pt.sp_active):
1920	            kv_payload: dict[str, object] | None = None
1921	            if pt.is_leader:
1922	                if pt.cfg_active:
1923	                    payloads = (
1924	                        self._build_cfg_rank_local_payloads(req, pt.cfg_size) if received else [None] * pt.cfg_size
1925	                    )
1926	                    kv_payload = payloads[0]
1927	                    self._cfg_scatter(pt.cfg_group, payloads, pt.cfg_size, device, self._resolve_request_id(req))
1928	                elif pt.sp_active:
1929	                    kv_payload = self._collect_request_kv_payload(req) if received else None
1930	                if pt.sp_active and pt.sp_group is not None:
1931	                    kv_payload = self._broadcast_kv_payload(pt.sp_group, kv_payload, device, src=0)
1932	            elif pt.is_follower:
1933	                if pt.cfg_active and pt.sp_rank == 0:
1934	                    kv_payload = self._recv_kv_payload(pt.cfg_group, 0, device)
1935	                if pt.sp_active and pt.sp_group is not None:
1936	                    kv_payload = self._broadcast_kv_payload(pt.sp_group, kv_payload, device, src=0)
1937	            else:
1938	                logger.error("distribute_kv_cache: unexpected role %s in TP+CFG/SP path", pt.role)
1939	                return None
1940	            return kv_payload or None
1941	
1942	        # TP inactive, world broadcast
1943	        kv_payload = None
1944	        if pt.is_leader and received:
1945	            kv_payload = self._collect_request_kv_payload(req)
1946	        kv_payload = self._broadcast_kv_payload(pt.world, kv_payload, device, src=0)
1947	        return kv_payload or None
1948	
1949	
1950	def _drop_prefetch_result(fut: Any) -> None:
1951	    try:
1952	        if not fut.cancelled():
1953	            fut.result()
1954	    except Exception:
1955	        pass
1956	
1957	
1958	def _move_to_device(obj: object, device: torch.device) -> object:
1959	    """Recursively move tensors inside a KV cache object to *device*."""
1960	    if isinstance(obj, torch.Tensor):
1961	        return obj.to(device).contiguous() if obj.device != device else obj
1962	    if hasattr(obj, "__dict__"):
1963	        for k, v in vars(obj).items():
1964	            setattr(obj, k, _move_to_device(v, device))
1965	        return obj
1966	    if isinstance(obj, dict):
1967	        return {k: _move_to_device(v, device) for k, v in obj.items()}
1968	    if isinstance(obj, list):
1969	        return [_move_to_device(v, device) for v in obj]
1970	    return obj

42	def initialize_connectors_from_config(
43	    config_path: str | Path | None = None,
44	    purpose: str = "request_forwarding",

71	    connectors_config: dict[tuple[str, str], ConnectorSpec],
72	    purpose: str = "request_forwarding",
73	    caller_stage_id: int | str | None = None,
74	    is_sender: bool | None = None,
75	) -> dict[tuple[str, str], OmniConnectorBase]:

82	    Returns:

85	    purpose_port_offsets = {

88	    }

92	    connectors = {}
93	    for edge_key, connector_spec in connectors_config.items():
94	        from_stage, to_stage = edge_key
95	        try:

146	def get_connectors_config_for_stage(transfer_config: OmniTransferConfig | None, stage_id: str | int) -> dict[str, Any]:
147	    """
148	    Extract connector configurations relevant for a specific stage worker.
149	
150	    Returns a dict compatible with worker initialization:
151	    {
152	        "from_stage_X": {
153	            "spec": {
154	                "name": "ConnectorName",
155	                "extra": {...}
156	            }
157	        },
158	        ...
159	    }

161	    if not transfer_config:
162	        return {}

164	    stage_connectors_config = {}

166	
167	    # Iterate through all configured edges and inject direction-specific role.
168	    # The shared edge-level ConnectorSpec is role-neutral; each stage gets
169	    # the correct role ("sender" or "receiver") based on its position in
170	    # the edge so that MooncakeTransferEngineConnector (and any future
171	    # role-aware connector) initializes correctly.
172	    for (from_stage, to_stage), spec in transfer_config.connectors.items():
173	        if to_stage == target_stage:

175	            extra = dict(spec.extra) if spec.extra else {}
176	            extra.setdefault("role", "receiver")

198	    if config_path is not None:
199	        config_path = Path(config_path)
200	        if not config_path.exists():
201	            raise FileNotFoundError(f"Config file not found: {config_path}")
202	
203	        with open(config_path, encoding="utf-8") as f:
204	            if config_path.suffix.lower() == ".json":
205	                config_dict = json.load(f)
206	            elif config_path.suffix.lower() in [".yaml", ".yml"]:
207	                try:
208	                    import yaml

211	                except ImportError:
212	                    raise ImportError("PyYAML required for YAML config files")
213	            else:

221	    if "stages" in config_dict and "stage_args" not in config_dict:

223	        runtime = dict(normalized.get("runtime") or {})

225	            runtime["connectors"] = normalized["connectors"]
226	        if "edges" in normalized and "edges" not in runtime:

235	
236	    # Parse global connectors (from runtime.connectors)
237	    global_connectors = runtime_config.get("connectors", {})
238	
239	    # Parse stage-level connectors
240	    stage_args = config_dict.get("stage_args", [])
241	    expected_edges: set[tuple[str, str]] = set()
242	    for stage_config in stage_args:
243	        stage_id = str(stage_config["stage_id"])
244	
245	        # Input connectors (this stage is the receiver)
246	        # NOTE: role is NOT injected here — the shared edge-level ConnectorSpec
247	        # must remain role-neutral.  Role is injected per-stage in
248	        # get_connectors_config_for_stage() / resolve_omni_kv_config_for_stage().
249	        for input_key, conn_ref in stage_config.get("input_connectors", {}).items():
250	            if isinstance(conn_ref, str):

254	                    extra = dict(conn_config.get("extra", {}))
255	                else:
256	                    raise ValueError(f"Undefined connector reference: {conn_ref}")
257	                connector = ConnectorSpec(name=conn_config["name"], extra=extra)
258	            else:
259	                # Inline connector definition
260	                extra = dict(conn_ref.get("extra", {}))
261	                connector = ConnectorSpec(name=conn_ref["name"], extra=extra)

272	                        f"Connector type mismatch for edge {edge_key[0]}->{edge_key[1]}: "
273	                        f"previously registered as '{existing.name}', "
274	                        f"but input_connectors of stage {stage_id} specifies '{connector.name}'"
275	                    )
276	            else:
277	                connectors[edge_key] = connector
278	            expected_edges.add(edge_key)

280	        # Output connectors (this stage is the sender)
281	        for output_key, conn_ref in stage_config.get("output_connectors", {}).items():
282	            if isinstance(conn_ref, str):

284	                if conn_ref in global_connectors:

287	                else:

292	                extra = dict(conn_ref.get("extra", {}))
293	                connector = ConnectorSpec(name=conn_ref["name"], extra=extra)
294

297	            edge_key = (stage_id, to_stage)
298	            if edge_key in connectors:
299	                existing = connectors[edge_key]
300	                if existing.name != connector.name:
301	                    raise ValueError(
302	                        f"Connector type mismatch for edge {edge_key[0]}->{edge_key[1]}: "
303	                        f"previously registered as '{existing.name}', "
304	                        f"but output_connectors of stage {stage_id} specifies '{connector.name}'"
305	                    )
306	            else:
307	                connectors[edge_key] = connector
308	            expected_edges.add(edge_key)
309	
310	    # Auto-configure SharedMemoryConnector for missing edges based on runtime edges / engine_input_source
311	    if stage_args:
312	        try:
313	            # Prefer explicit runtime edges if provided
314	            runtime_edges = runtime_config.get("edges", [])
315	            if isinstance(runtime_edges, list) and runtime_edges:
316	                for edge in runtime_edges:
317	                    from_stage = edge.get("from")
318	                    to_stage = edge.get("to")
319	                    if from_stage is None or to_stage is None:
320	                        continue
321	                    edge_key = (str(from_stage), str(to_stage))
322	                    expected_edges.add(edge_key)
323	                    if edge_key not in connectors:
324	                        logger.info(f"Auto-configuring SharedMemoryConnector for edge {edge_key}")
325	                        connectors[edge_key] = ConnectorSpec(name="SharedMemoryConnector")
326	
327	            # Fallback: infer edges from engine_input_source for each stage
328	            for stage_config in stage_args:
329	                to_stage = str(stage_config["stage_id"])
330	                # Check explicit input sources
331	                sources = stage_config.get("engine_input_source", [])
332	
333	                for from_stage in sources:
334	                    from_stage_str = str(from_stage)
335	                    edge_key = (from_stage_str, to_stage)
336	                    expected_edges.add(edge_key)
337	
338	                    if edge_key not in connectors:
339	                        logger.info(f"Auto-configuring SharedMemoryConnector for edge {edge_key}")
340	                        connectors[edge_key] = ConnectorSpec(name="SharedMemoryConnector")
341	
342	        except Exception as e:
343	            logger.warning(f"Failed to auto-configure SHM connectors: {e}")
344	
345	    # Fail fast if any expected edge is still missing a connector
346	    missing_edges = [edge for edge in expected_edges if edge not in connectors]
347	    if missing_edges:
348	        missing_str = ", ".join([f"{f}->{t}" for f, t in missing_edges])
349	        raise ValueError(
350	            "Connector configuration missing for edges: "
351	            f"{missing_str}. Define connectors or allow auto SHM creation for these edges."
352	        )
353	
354	    config = OmniTransferConfig(connectors=connectors)
355	
356	    logger.info(f"Loaded OmniTransferConfig with {len(connectors)} connector configurations")
357	    return config
358

360	# High-level management functions
361	
362	
363	def initialize_orchestrator_connectors(
364	    config_path: str | None,
365	) -> tuple[OmniTransferConfig | None, dict[tuple[str, str], OmniConnectorBase]]:
366	    """Initialize connectors shared at orchestrator level.
367	    Args:
368	        config_path: The path to the configuration file.
369	    Returns:
370	        A tuple containing the OmniTransferConfig and a dictionary of connectors.
371	    """
372	    transfer_config, connectors = initialize_connectors_from_config(
373	        config_path,
374	        purpose="request_forwarding",
375	        caller_stage_id="orchestrator",
376	        is_sender=True,
377	    )
378	    return transfer_config, connectors

381	def get_stage_connector_config(
382	    transfer_config: OmniTransferConfig | None,
383	    stage_id: int,
384	) -> dict[str, Any]:
385	    """Return the serialized connector config payload for a specific stage."""
386	    if transfer_config is None:
387	        return {}
388	
389	    try:
390	        return get_connectors_config_for_stage(transfer_config, stage_id)
391	    except Exception as exc:  # pragma: no cover - defensive logging
392	        logger.warning(
393	            "Failed to build connector config for stage %s: %s. Using IPC fallback.",
394	            stage_id,
395	            exc,
396	        )
397	        return {}
398	
399	
400	def build_stage_connectors(
401	    stage_id: int,
402	    connectors_config: dict[str, Any],
403	    purpose: str = "request_forwarding",
404	) -> dict[tuple[str, str], Any] | None:
405	    """Instantiate OmniConnectors for a stage based on config.
406	
407	    Deprecated: prefer ``get_stage_connector_config`` plus the unified
408	    connector factory. Kept as a thin shim so legacy callers keep working.
409	    """
410	    warnings.warn(
411	        "build_stage_connectors is deprecated; use get_stage_connector_config and OmniConnectorFactory instead.",
412	        DeprecationWarning,
413	        stacklevel=2,
414	    )
415	    if not connectors_config:
416	        return {}
417	
418	    logger.info(
419	        "[Stage-%s] Initializing OmniConnectors with config keys: %s",
420	        stage_id,
421	        list(connectors_config.keys()),
422	    )
423	
424	    from .config import ConnectorSpec
425	
426	    connectors: dict[tuple[str, str], Any] = {}
427	    # Convert dictionary-formatted config to ConnectorSpec objects.
428	    # Only instantiate INPUT connectors ("from_stage_X") — the stage worker
429	    # only receives via connectors.  Output connectors are handled at the
430	    # orchestrator level (try_send_via_connector uses orchestrator connectors).
431	    stage_connector_specs = {}
432	    for key, config in connectors_config.items():
433	        if not key.startswith("from_stage_"):
434	            continue
435	
436	        from_stage = key.replace("from_stage_", "")
437	        spec_dict = config.get("spec", {})
438	        if not spec_dict:
439	            continue
440	
441	        connector_spec = ConnectorSpec(
442	            name=spec_dict.get("name", "SharedMemoryConnector"),
443	            extra=spec_dict.get("extra", {}),
444	        )
445	        stage_connector_specs[(str(from_stage), str(stage_id))] = connector_spec
446	
447	    try:
448	        # Use unified connector creation logic
449	        connectors = create_connectors_from_config(
450	            stage_connector_specs,
451	            purpose=purpose,
452	            caller_stage_id=stage_id,
453	            is_sender=False,
454	        )
455	    except Exception as exc:  # pragma: no cover - defensive logging
456	        # Fail fast so the stage does not start with missing connectors.
457	        logger.exception("[Stage-%s] Failed to initialize connectors: %s", stage_id, exc)
458	        raise
459	
460	    return connectors
461	
462	
463	def resolve_omni_kv_config_for_stage(
464	    transfer_cfg: OmniTransferConfig | None, stage_id: int | str
465	) -> tuple[dict[str, Any] | None, str | None, str | None]:
466	    """Resolve connector configuration for a specific stage (Sender/Receiver).
467	
468	    This determines the primary connector configuration to be injected into the
469	    engine arguments, prioritizing outgoing edges (Sender role).
470	    """
471	    if not transfer_cfg or not getattr(transfer_cfg, "connectors", None):
472	        return None, None, None
473	
474	    stage_id_str = str(stage_id)
475	
476	    # Find outgoing edges (Sender logic)
477	    outgoing = [
478	        (to_stage, spec)
479	        for (from_stage, to_stage), spec in transfer_cfg.connectors.items()
480	        if from_stage == stage_id_str
481	    ]
482	
483	    # Find incoming edges (Receiver logic)
484	    incoming = [
485	        (from_stage, spec)
486	        for (from_stage, to_stage), spec in transfer_cfg.connectors.items()
487	        if to_stage == stage_id_str
488	    ]
489	
490	    omni_conn_cfg = None
491	    omni_from = None
492	    omni_to = None
493	
494	    # Prioritize outgoing (Sender) if exists, else check incoming (Receiver).
495	    # Inject direction-specific role so the connector initializes correctly.
496	    if outgoing:
497	        if len(outgoing) > 1:
498	            logger.debug(
499	                "Stage-%s has %d outgoing edges; using the smallest to_stage",
500	                stage_id,
501	                len(outgoing),
502	            )
503	        outgoing.sort(key=lambda x: int(x[0]) if str(x[0]).isdigit() else str(x[0]))
504	        to_s, spec = outgoing[0]
505	        omni_conn_cfg = {"type": spec.name, **(spec.extra or {})}
506	        omni_conn_cfg.setdefault("role", "sender")
507	        omni_from = stage_id_str
508	        omni_to = str(to_s)
509	    elif incoming:
510	        # For receiver, pick one incoming edge to configure the connector
511	        incoming.sort(key=lambda x: int(x[0]) if str(x[0]).isdigit() else str(x[0]))
512	        from_s, spec = incoming[0]
513	        omni_conn_cfg = {"type": spec.name, **(spec.extra or {})}
514	        omni_conn_cfg.setdefault("role", "receiver")
515	        omni_from = str(from_s)
516	        omni_to = stage_id_str
517	
518	    return omni_conn_cfg, omni_from, omni_to
519

# Disaggregated Inference for Omni-Modality Models

This guide explains how to configure and use distributed connectors
(`vllm_omni/distributed/omni_connectors`) in vllm-omni for multi-stage pipelines.

Backend-specific setup lives in separate docs:

- [SharedMemoryConnector](omni_connectors/shared_memory_connector.md)
- [MooncakeStoreConnector](omni_connectors/mooncake_store_connector.md)
- [MooncakeTransferEngineConnector](omni_connectors/mooncake_transfer_engine_connector.md)
- [MoriTransferEngineConnector](omni_connectors/mori_transfer_engine_connector.md)
- [YuanrongConnector](omni_connectors/yuanrong_connector.md)
- [YuanrongTransferEngineConnector](omni_connectors/yuanrong_transfer_engine_connector.md)

## Overview

Connectors enable data transfer between pipeline stages (e.g., Thinker -> Talker).
Current connectors operate in D2H2D (device to host to device) mode.

## Connector Choices

| Use Case | Recommended Connector | Notes |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| Single node | SharedMemoryConnector | Auto-configured if no connector is specified. |
| Multi node (Mooncake Store) | MooncakeStoreConnector | TCP-based, requires Mooncake Master + metadata server. |
| Multi node (Mooncake RDMA) | MooncakeTransferEngineConnector | RDMA/TCP direct transfer with managed memory pool. Fastest. |
| Multi node (Mori RDMA) | MoriTransferEngineConnector | RDMA direct transfer via Mori IOEngine. |
| Multi node (Yuanrong) | YuanrongConnector | Requires Yuanrong Datasystem + etcd. |
| Ascend NPU P2P (Yuanrong TE) | YuanrongTransferEngineConnector | Uses Yuanrong TransferEngine directly. Configure NPU device IPv4 and `memory_pool_device: "npu"`. |

## Core API

The connector system is built around `OmniConnectorBase`.

```python
class OmniConnectorBase(ABC):
    @abstractmethod
    def put(self, from_stage: str, to_stage: str, put_key: str, data: Any) -> tuple[bool, int, Optional[dict]]:
        """
        Store data.
        Returns: (success, serialized_size, metadata)
        """
        pass

    @abstractmethod
    def get(self, from_stage: str, to_stage: str, get_key: str, metadata: Optional[dict] = None) -> Optional[tuple[Any, int]]:
        """
        Retrieve data.
        Args: metadata - transport-specific handles returned by put() (e.g., SHM name).
        Returns: (object, serialized_size)
        """
        pass
```

### Metadata Passing

Some connectors (e.g., SharedMemoryConnector) generate transient resources during `put()`.
This `metadata` must be passed through the control plane so `get()` can locate the data.

## Configuration Model

Define connectors in runtime:

```yaml
runtime:
  connectors:
    connector_of_shared_memory:
      name: SharedMemoryConnector
```

Wire stages to connectors:

```yaml
stage_args:
  - stage_id: 0
    output_connectors:
      to_stage_1: connector_of_shared_memory

  - stage_id: 1
    input_connectors:
      from_stage_0: connector_of_shared_memory
```

If a pipeline edge has no explicit connector, the system auto-creates a
SharedMemoryConnector for that edge.

## Relationship with vLLM

vLLM provides specialized distributed mechanisms for specific artifacts:

- KV Transfer (`vllm.distributed.kv_transfer`): optimized for KV caches.
- EC Transfer (`vllm.distributed.ec_transfer`): optimized for encoder embeddings.
- Device Communicators (`vllm.distributed.device_communicators`): low-level primitives (NCCL, SHM).

vllm-omni complements this with a generalized connector abstraction:

1. Unifies transport via a single `put`/`get` API for any stage artifact.
2. Enables DAG-style pipelines across processes or nodes with per-edge transports.
3. Can wrap vLLM-specific transfers for KV paths while keeping a consistent interface.

## Operational Notes

- Fail-fast config validation: missing expected edges cause startup failures.
- Missing payloads halt stages: verify connector wiring and metadata propagation.

## Future Roadmap: D2D Transport

Current connectors use D2H2D paths. Future versions will introduce direct
device-to-device connectors (NCCL, UCX, IPC) to reduce latency for large
tensor payloads.

4	from collections.abc import Mapping
5	from dataclasses import asdict, is_dataclass
6	from typing import Any
7	
8	import msgspec
9	import numpy as np
10	import torch
11	from msgspec import msgpack
12	from PIL import Image
13	from vllm.outputs import CompletionOutput, RequestOutput
14	
15	# Type markers for custom serialization
16	_TENSOR_MARKER = "__tensor__"
17	_NDARRAY_MARKER = "__ndarray__"
18	_PIL_IMAGE_MARKER = "__pil_image__"
19	
20	# Keys that identify a RequestOutput dict (for reconstruction)
21	_REQUEST_OUTPUT_KEYS = frozenset({"request_id", "prompt", "prompt_token_ids", "outputs", "finished"})
22	
23	# Keys that identify a CompletionOutput dict (for reconstruction)
24	_COMPLETION_OUTPUT_KEYS = frozenset({"index", "text", "token_ids", "finish_reason"})
25	
26	# Keys that identify an OmniRequestOutput dict (for reconstruction)
27	# OmniRequestOutput has 'final_output_type' which is unique, or can be identified by
28	# having 'finished' and ('images' or 'final_output_type')
29	_OMNI_REQUEST_OUTPUT_KEYS = frozenset({"finished", "final_output_type"})
30	
31	
32	class OmniMsgpackEncoder:
33	    """
34	    This implementation is adapted from vLLM’s MsgpackEncoder.
35	    However, zero-copy support has not been implemented yet.
36	    Handles torch.Tensor, numpy.ndarray, PIL.Image, RequestOutput and
37	    CompletionOutput by converting them to serializable dict representations.
38	    TODO: Enable zero-copy support.
39	    """
40	
41	    def __init__(self):
42	        self.encoder = msgpack.Encoder(enc_hook=self._enc_hook)
43	
44	    def encode(self, obj: Any) -> bytes:
45	        """Encode an object to bytes."""
46	        return self.encoder.encode(obj)
47	
48	    def _enc_hook(self, obj: Any) -> Any:
49	        """Custom encoding hook for non-standard types."""
50	        # torch.Tensor
51	        if isinstance(obj, torch.Tensor):
52	            return self._encode_tensor(obj)
53	
54	        # numpy.ndarray (exclude object/void dtypes)
55	        if isinstance(obj, np.ndarray) and obj.dtype.kind not in ("O", "V"):
56	            return self._encode_ndarray(obj)
57	
58	        # PIL.Image
59	        if isinstance(obj, Image.Image):
60	            return self._encode_pil_image(obj)
61	
62	        # RequestOutput (not a dataclass, needs special handling)
63	        if isinstance(obj, RequestOutput):
64	            return self._encode_request_output(obj)
65	
66	        # CompletionOutput (dataclass)
67	        if isinstance(obj, CompletionOutput):
68	            return self._encode_completion_output(obj)
69	
70	        # Other dataclasses
71	        if is_dataclass(obj) and not isinstance(obj, type):
72	            return asdict(obj)
73	
74	        # slice
75	        if isinstance(obj, slice):
76	            return (obj.start, obj.stop, obj.step)
77	
78	        raise TypeError(
79	            f"Object of type {type(obj).__name__} is not serializable. "
80	            "Supported types: torch.Tensor, np.ndarray, PIL.Image, dataclass, "
81	            "RequestOutput, and standard Python types (dict, list, str, int, float, bool, None, bytes)."
82	        )
83	
84	    def _encode_tensor(self, tensor: torch.Tensor) -> dict[str, Any]:
85	        """Encode torch.Tensor to dict."""
86	        t = tensor.detach().cpu()
87	        # Handle 0-dimensional (scalar) tensors by reshaping to 1D first
88	        if t.dim() == 0:
89	            t = t.reshape(1)
90	        if not t.is_contiguous():
91	            t = t.contiguous()
92	        t = t.view(torch.uint8)
93	        return {
94	            _TENSOR_MARKER: True,
95	            "dtype": str(tensor.dtype).removeprefix("torch."),
96	            "shape": list(tensor.shape),
97	            "data": t.numpy().tobytes(),
98	        }
99	
100	    def _encode_ndarray(self, arr: np.ndarray) -> dict[str, Any]:
101	        """Encode numpy.ndarray to dict."""
102	        if not arr.flags.c_contiguous:
103	            arr = np.ascontiguousarray(arr)
104	        return {
105	            _NDARRAY_MARKER: True,
106	            "dtype": arr.dtype.str,
107	            "shape": list(arr.shape),
108	            "data": arr.tobytes(),
109	        }
110	
111	    def _encode_pil_image(self, img: Image.Image) -> dict[str, Any]:
112	        """Encode PIL.Image to dict."""
113	        arr = np.asarray(img, dtype=np.uint8)
114	        if not arr.flags.c_contiguous:
115	            arr = np.ascontiguousarray(arr)
116	        return {
117	            _PIL_IMAGE_MARKER: True,
118	            "mode": img.mode,
119	            "shape": list(arr.shape),
120	            "data": arr.tobytes(),
121	        }
122	
123	    def _encode_request_output(self, obj: RequestOutput) -> dict[str, Any]:
124	        """Encode RequestOutput to dict.
125	
126	        RequestOutput is not a dataclass, so we manually extract its attributes.
127	        Also handles dynamically added 'multimodal_output' attribute.
128	        """
129	        # msgspec can serialize CompletionOutput dataclasses directly, but it
130	        # drops dynamic fields such as multimodal_output. Encode them manually
131	        # to preserve multimodal payloads across IPC.
132	        encoded_outputs = []
133	        for o in obj.outputs:
134	            if isinstance(o, CompletionOutput):
135	                encoded_outputs.append(self._encode_completion_output(o))
136	            else:
137	                encoded_outputs.append(o)
138	
139	        result = {
140	            "request_id": obj.request_id,
141	            "prompt": obj.prompt,
142	            "prompt_token_ids": obj.prompt_token_ids,
143	            "prompt_logprobs": obj.prompt_logprobs,
144	            "outputs": encoded_outputs,
145	            "finished": obj.finished,
146	            "metrics": obj.metrics,
147	            "lora_request": obj.lora_request,
148	            "encoder_prompt": obj.encoder_prompt,
149	            "encoder_prompt_token_ids": obj.encoder_prompt_token_ids,
150	            "num_cached_tokens": obj.num_cached_tokens,
151	            "multi_modal_placeholders": getattr(obj, "multi_modal_placeholders", None),
152	            "kv_transfer_params": obj.kv_transfer_params,
153	        }
154	        # Handle multimodal_output attribute (MultimodalPayload or dict)
155	        mm_output = getattr(obj, "multimodal_output", None)
156	        if mm_output is not None:
157	            if isinstance(mm_output, Mapping):
158	                result["multimodal_output"] = dict(mm_output)
159	            else:
160	                result["multimodal_output"] = mm_output
161	        return result
162	
163	    def _encode_completion_output(self, obj: CompletionOutput) -> dict[str, Any]:
164	        """Encode CompletionOutput to dict, preserving multimodal payloads."""
165	        result = asdict(obj)
166	        mm_output = getattr(obj, "multimodal_output", None)
167	        if mm_output is not None:
168	            # Convert MultimodalPayload to plain dict for wire format
169	            if isinstance(mm_output, Mapping):
170	                result["multimodal_output"] = dict(mm_output)
171	            else:
172	                result["multimodal_output"] = mm_output
173	        return result

176	class OmniMsgpackDecoder:
177	    """
178	    This implementation is adapted from vLLM’s MsgpackDecoder.
179	    However, zero-copy support has not been implemented yet.
180	
181	    Automatically reconstructs torch.Tensor, numpy.ndarray, PIL.Image,
182	    RequestOutput and CompletionOutput from their dict representations.
183	    TODO: Enable zero-copy support.
184	    """
185	
186	    def __init__(self):
187	        self.decoder = msgpack.Decoder()
188	
189	    def decode(self, data: bytes | bytearray | memoryview) -> Any:
190	        """Decode bytes to object."""
191	        result = self.decoder.decode(data)
192	        return self._post_process(result)
193	
194	    def _post_process(self, obj: Any) -> Any:
195	        """Recursively restore tensor/ndarray/image/RequestOutput/OmniRequestOutput from their dict representations."""
196	        if isinstance(obj, dict):
197	            # Check for type markers first
198	            if obj.get(_TENSOR_MARKER):
199	                return self._decode_tensor(obj)
200	            if obj.get(_NDARRAY_MARKER):
201	                return self._decode_ndarray(obj)
202	            if obj.get(_PIL_IMAGE_MARKER):
203	                return self._decode_pil_image(obj)
204	
205	            # Process values recursively first
206	            processed = {k: self._post_process(v) for k, v in obj.items()}
207	
208	            # Check if this looks like an OmniRequestOutput (check before RequestOutput
209	            # since OmniRequestOutput may also have some RequestOutput-like fields)
210	            if self._is_omni_request_output(processed):
211	                return self._decode_omni_request_output(processed)
212	
213	            # Check if this looks like a RequestOutput
214	            if _REQUEST_OUTPUT_KEYS.issubset(processed.keys()):
215	                return self._decode_request_output(processed)
216	
217	            # Check if this looks like a CompletionOutput
218	            if _COMPLETION_OUTPUT_KEYS.issubset(processed.keys()):
219	                return self._decode_completion_output(processed)
220	
221	            return processed
222	
223	        if isinstance(obj, list):
224	            return [self._post_process(item) for item in obj]
225	
226	        if isinstance(obj, tuple):
227	            return tuple(self._post_process(item) for item in obj)
228	
229	        return obj
230	
231	    def _is_omni_request_output(self, obj: dict[str, Any]) -> bool:
232	        """Check if a dict looks like an OmniRequestOutput.
233	
234	        OmniRequestOutput can be identified by:
235	        - Having 'finished' and 'final_output_type' fields (unique to OmniRequestOutput)
236	        - OR having 'finished' and 'images' fields (diffusion mode)
237	        """
238	        # Must have 'finished' field
239	        if "finished" not in obj:
240	            return False
241	
242	        # Check for unique identifier: 'final_output_type'
243	        if "final_output_type" in obj:
244	            return True
245	
246	        # Alternative: check for 'images' field (diffusion mode)
247	        if "images" in obj:
248	            return True
249	
250	        return False
251	
252	    def _decode_omni_request_output(self, obj: dict[str, Any]) -> Any:
253	        """Decode dict to OmniRequestOutput.
254	
255	        OmniRequestOutput is a dataclass, so we can use msgspec.convert
256	        or construct it directly.
257	        """
258	        from vllm_omni.outputs import OmniRequestOutput
259	
260	        try:
261	            # Use msgspec.convert for dataclass reconstruction
262	            return msgspec.convert(obj, OmniRequestOutput)
263	        except Exception:
264	            try:
265	                # Fallback: construct directly if msgspec.convert fails
266	                # (e.g., if some fields are missing or have wrong types)
267	                return OmniRequestOutput(**obj)
268	            except Exception:
269	                # If both attempts fail, return dict as-is (defensive fallback)
270	                # This should rarely happen if _is_omni_request_output is correct
271	                return obj
272	
273	    def _decode_tensor(self, obj: dict[str, Any]) -> torch.Tensor:
274	        """Decode dict to torch.Tensor."""
275	        dtype_str = obj["dtype"]
276	        shape = obj["shape"]
277	        data = obj["data"]
278	
279	        torch_dtype = getattr(torch, dtype_str)
280	        if not data:
281	            return torch.empty(shape, dtype=torch_dtype)
282	
283	        buffer = bytearray(data) if isinstance(data, (bytes, memoryview)) else data
284	        arr = torch.frombuffer(buffer, dtype=torch.uint8)
285	        return arr.view(torch_dtype).reshape(shape)
286	
287	    def _decode_ndarray(self, obj: dict[str, Any]) -> np.ndarray:
288	        """Decode dict to numpy.ndarray."""
289	        dtype = obj["dtype"]
290	        shape = obj["shape"]
291	        data = obj["data"]
292	        return np.frombuffer(data, dtype=dtype).reshape(shape)
293	
294	    def _decode_pil_image(self, obj: dict[str, Any]) -> Image.Image:
295	        """Decode dict to PIL.Image."""
296	        mode = obj["mode"]
297	        shape = obj["shape"]
298	        data = obj["data"]
299	        arr = np.frombuffer(data, dtype=np.uint8).reshape(shape)
300	        return Image.fromarray(arr, mode=mode)
301	
302	    def _decode_completion_output(self, obj: dict[str, Any]) -> CompletionOutput:
303	        """Decode dict to CompletionOutput using msgspec.convert."""
304	        mm_output = obj.pop("multimodal_output", None)
305	        co = msgspec.convert(obj, CompletionOutput)
306	        if mm_output is not None:
307	            setattr(co, "multimodal_output", mm_output)
308	        return co
309	
310	    def _decode_request_output(self, obj: dict[str, Any]) -> RequestOutput:
311	        """Decode dict to RequestOutput.
312	
313	        RequestOutput is not a dataclass, so msgspec.convert doesn't work.
314	        We construct it manually using only the known __init__ parameters to
315	        avoid triggering the "Ignoring extra arguments" warning in vllm.
316	        Fields that are not part of RequestOutput.__init__ (e.g.
317	        multi_modal_placeholders, multimodal_output) are extracted first and
318	        then restored as dynamic attributes after construction.
319	        """
320	        # Extract dynamically-added / non-init fields before constructing so
321	        # they are not passed as unknown **kwargs to RequestOutput.__init__.
322	        mm_output = obj.pop("multimodal_output", None)
323	        multi_modal_placeholders = obj.pop("multi_modal_placeholders", None)
324	
325	        ro = RequestOutput(**obj)
326	
327	        # Restore dynamic attributes that are not part of __init__.
328	        if multi_modal_placeholders is not None:
329	            setattr(ro, "multi_modal_placeholders", multi_modal_placeholders)
330	        if mm_output is not None:
331	            setattr(ro, "multimodal_output", mm_output)
332	        return ro
333	
334	
335	class OmniSerde:
336	    """Serialization/deserialization handler for Omni IPC."""
337	
338	    def __init__(self):
339	        self.encoder = OmniMsgpackEncoder()
340	        self.decoder = OmniMsgpackDecoder()
341	
342	    def serialize(self, obj: Any) -> bytes:
343	        """Serialize an object to bytes."""
344	        return self.encoder.encode(obj)
345	
346	    def deserialize(self, data: bytes | bytearray | memoryview) -> Any:
347	        """Deserialize bytes to an object."""
348	        return self.decoder.decode(data)
349	
350	
351	# Global instance for simple interface
352	OmniSerializer = OmniSerde()

73	class MooncakeTransferEngineConnector(OmniConnectorBase):
74	    """
75	    OmniConnector implementation using Mooncake Transfer Engine with a managed memory pool.
76	    Supports both CPU (Pinned) and GPU memory pools, and both RDMA and TCP protocols.
77	    Topology limitations (current implementation):
78	        Current design focuses on peer-to-peer communication between stages.
79	        - **1 sender → 1 receiver per key**: After a successful RDMA write the
80	          sender immediately cleans up the buffer (``cleanup()``), so only the
81	          first receiver to pull a given key will succeed.  Broadcast / multicast
82	          (1 sender → N receivers sharing the same data) is not yet supported.
83	        - **1 receiver → N senders**: Supported via partial metadata.  The
84	          manager constructs metadata with the target sender's
85	          ``source_host`` / ``source_port`` (computed from ``from_rank``)
86	          and passes it to ``get(metadata=...)``.  The connector detects
87	          that ``data_size`` is missing, queries the specified sender at
88	          the given address to fill it in, then performs the RDMA pull.
89	          This enables heterogeneous TP (sender TP > receiver TP) where a
90	          single receiver must pull KV shards from multiple sender ranks.
91	
92	    Future work:
93	        - Support 1 sender → N receivers (e.g. reference-counted buffers, or
94	          explicit ``retain()`` / ``release()`` semantics so the buffer survives
95	          multiple pulls).
96	    """
97	
98	    # RDMA connector copies raw bytes/tensor directly to the memory pool
99	    # without going through OmniSerializer, so the sender can use
100	    # to_gpu_tensor() / to_bytes() fast-paths.
101	    supports_raw_data: bool = True
102	
103	    def __init__(self, config: dict[str, Any]):
104	        if TransferEngine is None:
105	            raise ImportError("Mooncake not available")
106	
107	        self._closed = False
108	        self._bind_error: Exception | None = None  # fatal ZMQ bind error from listener thread
109	
110	        # --- Early init of all teardown-related fields ---
111	        # If __init__ fails later (engine init, pool alloc, etc.), __del__ → close()
112	        # must not crash on missing attributes.  Safe defaults here ensure close()
113	        # can always run without AttributeError.
114	        self._stop_event = threading.Event()
115	        self._sender_executor: ThreadPoolExecutor | None = None
116	        self._listener_thread: threading.Thread | None = None
117	        self._listener_ready = threading.Event()
118	        self._local_buffers: dict[str, Any] = {}
119	        self._local_buffers_lock = threading.Lock()
120	        self._put_lock = threading.Lock()
121	        self._req_local = threading.local()
122	        self._worker_local = threading.local()
123	        self._last_ttl_check: float = _time_mod.monotonic()
124	        self._sender_endpoints: dict[int, tuple[str, int]] = {}
125	        self._in_flight_buffers: set[str] = set()
126	
127	        self._metrics = {
128	            "puts": 0,
129	            "gets": 0,
130	            "bytes_transferred": 0,
131	            "errors": 0,
132	            "timeouts": 0,
133	        }
134	
135	        self.config = config
136	        host_config = config.get("host")
137	        host_value = "auto" if host_config is None else str(host_config)
138	        # Default sender/receiver bootstrap to a routable local IP so the
139	        # advertised endpoint matches the interface Mooncake binds.
140	        if host_value.lower() == "auto" or host_value in {"", "*", "0.0.0.0", "::"}:
141	            self.host = self._get_local_ip()
142	            logger.info(f"Auto-detected local IP for RDMA: {self.host}")
143	        else:
144	            self.host = host_value
145	        self.zmq_port = config.get("zmq_port", 50051)
146	        self.protocol = config.get("protocol", "rdma")
147	
148	        # --- RDMA Device Configuration ---
149	        # Specify device names to filter (comma-separated), or empty for all devices.
150	        # Example: "mlx5_0,mlx5_1" to use only specific NICs.
151	        # This is important for environments with mixed InfiniBand/RoCE NICs.
152	        self.device_name = config.get("device_name", "")
153	        if not self.device_name:
154	            env_device = os.environ.get("RDMA_DEVICE_NAME", "")
155	            if env_device:
156	                self.device_name = env_device
157	                logger.info(f"Using RDMA_DEVICE_NAME from env: {self.device_name}")
158	
159	        # --- Memory Pool Configuration ---
160	        self.pool_size = config.get("memory_pool_size", 1024**3)  # Default 1GB
161	        self.pool_device = config.get("memory_pool_device", "cpu")
162	        self.buffer_ttl_seconds = float(config.get("buffer_ttl_seconds", _BUFFER_TTL_SECONDS))
163	
164	        # --- Sender Configuration (for receiver to query without metadata) ---
165	        # When receiver doesn't have metadata, it uses these to connect to sender
166	        self.sender_host = config.get("sender_host", None)
167	        self.sender_zmq_port = config.get("sender_zmq_port", None)
168	
169	        # --- Role ---
170	        # "sender": bind ZMQ listener, accept put() calls.
171	        # "receiver": skip ZMQ bind, only accept get() calls.
172	        # The orchestration layer (get_connectors_config_for_stage /
173	        # kv_transfer_manager) is responsible for injecting the correct role.
174	        role = str(config.get("role", "sender")).lower()
175	        if role not in {"sender", "receiver"}:
176	            raise ValueError(
177	                f"Invalid role={role!r} for MooncakeTransferEngineConnector. Expected 'sender' or 'receiver'."
178	            )
179	        self.can_put = role == "sender"
180	
181	        self.engine_id = str(uuid.uuid4())
182	
183	        self._init_engine()
184	        self._init_pool()
185	        self._init_listener(config)
186	
187	    def _init_engine(self) -> None:
188	        """Initialize the Mooncake engine and discover the local RPC port."""
189	        self.engine = TransferEngine()
190	        # Note: For P2P handshake mode, local_hostname should be just the IP address.
191	        # Mooncake will auto-assign an RPC port, retrievable via get_rpc_port().
192	        ret = self.engine.initialize(self.host, "P2PHANDSHAKE", self.protocol, self.device_name)
193	        if ret != 0:
194	            raise RuntimeError(f"Mooncake Engine initialization failed with code {ret}")
195	
196	        self.rpc_port = self.engine.get_rpc_port()
197	        logger.info(f"MooncakeTransferEngineConnector initialized at {self.host}:{self.rpc_port}")
198	
199	    def _init_pool(self) -> None:
200	        """Allocate and register the memory pool used by TransferEngine."""
201	        logger.info(f"Allocating RDMA Memory Pool: {self.pool_size / 1024**2:.2f} MB on {self.pool_device}")
202	        try:
203	            if self.pool_device == "cpu":
204	                self.pool = torch.empty(self.pool_size, dtype=torch.uint8).pin_memory()
205	                self.base_ptr = self.pool.data_ptr()
206	            else:
207	                self.pool = torch.empty(self.pool_size, dtype=torch.uint8, device=self.pool_device)
208	                self.base_ptr = self.pool.data_ptr()
209	
210	            # Register the entire pool
211	            ret = self.engine.register_memory(self.base_ptr, self.pool_size)
212	            if ret != 0:
213	                raise RuntimeError("Failed to register memory pool with Mooncake Engine")
214	
215	        except Exception as e:
216	            logger.error(f"Failed to allocate/register memory pool: {e}")
217	            raise
218	
219	        self.allocator = BufferAllocator(self.pool_size, alignment=4096)  # 4KB alignment for safety
220	
221	    def _init_listener(self, config: dict[str, Any]) -> None:
222	        """Initialize control-plane sockets and start the sender listener."""
223	        self.zmq_ctx = zmq.Context()
224	        self._sender_executor = ThreadPoolExecutor(max_workers=4, thread_name_prefix="mooncake-sender")
225	
226	        # Log complete connector configuration for debugging
227	        logger.info(
228	            f"MooncakeTransferEngineConnector config summary:\n"
229	            f"  Local: host={self.host}, zmq_port={self.zmq_port}, rpc_port={self.rpc_port}\n"
230	            f"  Remote: sender_host={self.sender_host}, sender_zmq_port={self.sender_zmq_port}\n"
231	            f"  Role: can_put={self.can_put}, configured_role={config.get('role', 'sender')}"
232	        )
233	
234	        # Only sender needs ZMQ listener to handle pull requests
235	        if self.can_put:
236	            self._last_ttl_check = _time_mod.monotonic()  # reset after slow init
237	            self._listener_thread = threading.Thread(target=self._zmq_listener_loop, daemon=True)
238	            self._listener_thread.start()
239	            # Wait briefly for listener to bind (or fail)
240	            self._listener_ready.wait(timeout=1.0)
241	            # Propagate any bind error to the caller — sender must bind successfully.
242	            if self._bind_error is not None:
243	                raise RuntimeError(
244	                    f"MooncakeTransferEngineConnector failed to bind ZMQ on "
245	                    f"{self.host}:{self.zmq_port}: {self._bind_error}"
246	                ) from self._bind_error
247	            logger.info(
248	                f"MooncakeTransferEngineConnector started as SENDER (ZMQ listener on {self.host}:{self.zmq_port})"
249	            )
250	        else:
251	            # Receiver mode — sender address is provided per-request via
252	            # metadata from put() through the queue, not pre-configured.
253	            if not self.sender_host or self.sender_host.lower() == "auto":
254	                logger.info(
255	                    "MooncakeTransferEngineConnector receiver: sender_host='auto', "
256	                    "awaiting sender info via task from orchestrator."
257	                )
258	            else:
259	                logger.info(
260	                    f"MooncakeTransferEngineConnector started as RECEIVER "
261	                    f"(will query sender at {self.sender_host}:{self.sender_zmq_port})"
262	                )
263	
264	    def get_connection_info(self) -> dict[str, Any]:
265	        """Get connection info for this connector (useful for sender to share with receivers)."""
266	        return {
267	            "host": self.host,
268	            "zmq_port": self.zmq_port,
269	            "rpc_port": self.rpc_port,
270	            "can_put": self.can_put,
271	        }
272	
273	    def update_sender_info(
274	        self,
275	        sender_host: str,
276	        sender_zmq_port: int,
277	        sender_rank: int | None = None,
278	    ) -> None:
279	        """Inject a sender's ZMQ endpoint into the receiver connector.
280	
281	        When ``sender_rank`` is ``None`` (default), sets the single default
282	        sender used by ``get()`` when no rank is specified — this preserves
283	        backward-compatible 1:1 semantics.
284	
285	        When ``sender_rank`` is an integer, the endpoint is stored in a
286	        per-rank registry for internal use (e.g. by
287	        ``_query_metadata_from_sender(sender_rank=R)``).
288	        """
289	        if sender_rank is not None:
290	            self._sender_endpoints[sender_rank] = (sender_host, sender_zmq_port)
291	            logger.info(
292	                "Sender info updated for rank %s: host=%r, zmq_port=%s",
293	                sender_rank,
294	                sender_host,
295	                sender_zmq_port,
296	            )
297	        else:
298	            self.sender_host = sender_host
299	            self.sender_zmq_port = sender_zmq_port
300	            logger.info(
301	                "Sender info updated (default): host=%r, zmq_port=%s",
302	                sender_host,
303	                sender_zmq_port,
304	            )
305	
306	    def _get_local_ip(self) -> str:
307	        """
308	        Auto-detect the local IP address that can be used for RDMA communication.
309	        This tries to get the IP that would be used to communicate externally,
310	        not the loopback address.
311	        """
312	        try:
313	            # Create a socket to determine the local IP used for external communication
314	            # We don't actually connect, just use the socket to get routing info
315	            with socket.socket(socket.AF_INET, socket.SOCK_DGRAM) as s:
316	                # Use Google's DNS as a target (doesn't actually connect)
317	                s.connect(("8.8.8.8", 80))
318	                local_ip = s.getsockname()[0]
319	            return local_ip
320	        except Exception as e:
321	            logger.warning(f"Failed to auto-detect local IP: {e}, falling back to hostname lookup")
322	            try:
323	                # Fallback: use hostname resolution
324	                hostname = socket.gethostname()
325	                local_ip = socket.gethostbyname(hostname)
326	                return local_ip
327	            except Exception as e2:
328	                logger.error(f"Failed to get local IP via hostname: {e2}, using 127.0.0.1")
329	                return "127.0.0.1"
330	
331	    def _get_req_socket(self, zmq_addr: str, timeout_ms: int) -> zmq.Socket:
332	        """Get or create a thread-local cached ZMQ REQ socket.
333	
334	        Each calling thread maintains its own ``{zmq_addr: socket}`` map
335	        stored in ``self._req_local``, so concurrent ``get()`` /
336	        ``_query_metadata_from_sender()`` calls from different threads
337	        never share a REQ socket — which would violate ZMQ's strict
338	        send→recv ordering constraint.
339	
340	        If a call fails, use ``_invalidate_req_socket()`` to discard the
341	        broken socket; the next call will transparently create a fresh one.
342	        """
343	        cache: dict[str, zmq.Socket] = getattr(self._req_local, "cache", None)  # type: ignore[assignment]
344	        if cache is None:
345	            cache = {}
346	            self._req_local.cache = cache
347	
348	        sock = cache.get(zmq_addr)
349	        if sock is None:
350	            sock = self.zmq_ctx.socket(zmq.REQ)
351	            sock.connect(zmq_addr)
352	            cache[zmq_addr] = sock
353	        # Set timeouts per-call (safe to change between send/recv cycles).
354	        # SNDTIMEO guards against send() blocking when the peer is unreachable
355	        # or its receive buffer is full.
356	        sock.setsockopt(zmq.SNDTIMEO, timeout_ms)
357	        sock.setsockopt(zmq.RCVTIMEO, timeout_ms)
358	        return sock
359	
360	    def _invalidate_req_socket(self, zmq_addr: str) -> None:
361	        """Close and remove a thread-local cached REQ socket (e.g., after recv timeout)."""
362	        cache: dict[str, zmq.Socket] = getattr(self._req_local, "cache", None)  # type: ignore[assignment]
363	        if cache is None:
364	            return
365	        sock = cache.pop(zmq_addr, None)
366	        if sock is not None:
367	            try:
368	                sock.close(linger=0)
369	            except Exception:
370	                pass  # Best-effort; zmq_ctx.term() will reclaim if needed

372	    def put(self, from_stage: str, to_stage: str, put_key: str, data: Any) -> tuple[bool, int, dict[str, Any] | None]:
373	        """
374	        Producer Side.
375	        Exposes data for RDMA transfer.
376	
377	        Behavior by data type:
378	        - ManagedBuffer (from this pool): Zero-copy, is_fast_path=True
379	        - ManagedBuffer (different pool): Fallback to tensor copy path
380	        - torch.Tensor / bytes: Copy to pool, is_fast_path=True
381	        - Other (dict, etc.): Serialize to bytes, copy to pool, is_fast_path=False
382	          (receiver will deserialize automatically)
383	        """
384	        if self._closed:
385	            raise RuntimeError("Cannot put data: MooncakeTransferEngineConnector is closed")
386	
387	        if not self.can_put:
388	            logger.warning(
389	                f"Rejecting put for {put_key}: connector is in receiver mode "
390	                f"(sender fallback occurred, ZMQ port likely occupied by another instance)"
391	            )
392	            return False, 0, None
393	
394	        put_key = self._make_key(put_key, from_stage, to_stage)
395	
396	        # Serialize concurrent put() calls on the same connector to prevent
397	        # races in the alloc -> copy -> store-metadata flow at the Mooncake
398	        # C++ engine level.
399	        with self._put_lock:
400	            return self._put_impl(put_key, data)
401	
402	    def _put_impl(self, put_key: str, data: Any) -> tuple[bool, int, dict[str, Any] | None]:
403	        """Internal put implementation, called under _put_lock."""
404	        try:
405	            src_addr = 0
406	            size = 0
407	            holder = None
408	            is_fast_path = True
409	            should_release_holder = False
410	
411	            # Reject empty data early — alloc(0) has undefined behaviour and
412	            # would leave a zombie entry in _local_buffers that the receiver
413	            # side can never consume (get() returns None for data_size==0).
414	            if isinstance(data, bytes) and len(data) == 0:
415	                logger.warning(f"Rejecting put for {put_key}: empty bytes payload")
416	                return False, 0, None
417	            if isinstance(data, torch.Tensor) and data.nbytes == 0:
418	                logger.warning(f"Rejecting put for {put_key}: zero-size tensor")
419	                return False, 0, None
420	
421	            # Pre-process: serialize non-raw types before entering the copy path.
422	            # This avoids the previous recursive put() pattern and keeps
423	            # _local_buffers writes atomic (single write, no override needed).
424	            if not isinstance(data, (ManagedBuffer, torch.Tensor, bytes)):
425	                data = OmniSerializer.serialize(data)
426	                is_fast_path = False  # Receiver must deserialize
427	
428	            if isinstance(data, ManagedBuffer):
429	                # Zero-Copy Path
430	                # Validate that the buffer belongs to this connector's pool.
431	                if data.pool_tensor.data_ptr() != self.pool.data_ptr():
432	                    # Fallback to copy path: extract tensor and let the
433	                    # torch.Tensor branch below handle the copy.
434	                    logger.warning("ManagedBuffer from different pool detected. Falling back to copy path.")
435	                    data = data.tensor.contiguous()
436	                    # Fall through to torch.Tensor branch
437	                else:
438	                    src_addr = self.base_ptr + data.offset
439	                    size = data.size
440	                    holder = data  # Keep the buffer alive
441	                    should_release_holder = False  # Caller owns it
442	
443	            # Use 'if' (not 'elif') so the ManagedBuffer fallback above can
444	            # convert to Tensor and flow into this branch seamlessly.
445	            if isinstance(data, (torch.Tensor, bytes)):
446	                # Copy Path
447	                # 1. Determine size
448	                if isinstance(data, torch.Tensor):
449	                    size = data.nbytes
450	                    tensor_data = data
451	                else:
452	                    size = len(data)
453	                    # Convert bytes to tensor for copy
454	                    tensor_data = torch.frombuffer(data, dtype=torch.uint8)
455	
456	                # 2. Alloc from pool
457	                try:
458	                    offset = self.allocator.alloc(size)
459	                    holder = ManagedBuffer(self.allocator, offset, size, self.pool)
460	                    should_release_holder = True  # We created it, we release it
461	                except MemoryError:
462	                    logger.error(f"Pool exhausted, cannot put data size {size}")
463	                    return False, 0, None
464	
465	                # 3. Copy data to pool
466	                # Handle device mismatch for copy
467	                try:
468	                    dst_tensor = holder.tensor
469	                    if isinstance(data, torch.Tensor):
470	                        if not data.is_contiguous():
471	                            data = data.contiguous()
472	
473	                        # View as flat uint8
474	                        src_view = data.view(torch.uint8).flatten()
475	                        if src_view.device != dst_tensor.device:
476	                            dst_tensor.copy_(src_view, non_blocking=True)
477	                            # Ensure copy is complete before exposing buffer to RDMA
478	                            # Must sync on SOURCE device for D2H copies, or DST for H2D
479	                            if src_view.is_cuda:
480	                                with torch.cuda.device(src_view.device):
481	                                    torch.cuda.current_stream().synchronize()
482	                            elif dst_tensor.is_cuda:
483	                                with torch.cuda.device(dst_tensor.device):
484	                                    torch.cuda.current_stream().synchronize()
485	                        else:
486	                            dst_tensor.copy_(src_view)
487	                            if dst_tensor.is_cuda:
488	                                with torch.cuda.device(dst_tensor.device):
489	                                    torch.cuda.current_stream().synchronize()
490	                    else:
491	                        # bytes -> tensor copy
492	                        # torch.frombuffer creates CPU tensor. If pool is GPU, copy_ handles H2D.
493	                        dst_tensor.copy_(tensor_data)
494	                        if dst_tensor.is_cuda:
495	                            with torch.cuda.device(dst_tensor.device):
496	                                torch.cuda.current_stream().synchronize()
497	                except Exception as e:
498	                    # Copy failed, release the allocated buffer to prevent leak
499	                    holder.release()
500	                    logger.error(f"Failed to copy data to pool: {e}")
501	                    return False, 0, None
502	
503	                src_addr = self.base_ptr + offset
504	
505	            # Final guard: reject zero-size payloads regardless of how they
506	            # got here (ManagedBuffer(size=0), empty serialization output, etc.).
507	            # This is the unified catch-all that complements the early checks
508	            # for bytes/Tensor above.
509	            if size <= 0:
510	                if should_release_holder and isinstance(holder, ManagedBuffer):
511	                    holder.release()
512	                logger.warning(f"Rejecting put for {put_key}: final payload size is {size}")
513	                return False, 0, None
514	
515	            with self._local_buffers_lock:
516	                # Release old buffer if put_key already exists (prevents pool leak)
517	                old_item = self._local_buffers.pop(put_key, None)
518	                if old_item:
519	                    _, _, old_holder, old_should_release, _, _ = old_item
520	                    if old_should_release and isinstance(old_holder, ManagedBuffer):
521	                        old_holder.release()
522	                        logger.warning(f"Released old buffer for duplicate put_key: {put_key}")
523	
524	                # Store: (src_addrs, lengths, holder, should_release, is_fast_path, created_at)
525	                self._local_buffers[put_key] = (
526	                    [src_addr],
527	                    [size],
528	                    holder,
529	                    should_release_holder,
530	                    is_fast_path,
531	                    _time_mod.monotonic(),
532	                )
533	
534	            # Metadata for Consumer
535	            metadata = {
536	                "source_host": self.host,
537	                "source_port": self.zmq_port,
538	                "data_size": size,
539	                "is_fast_path": is_fast_path,  # Hint: True = return ManagedBuffer, False = deserialize
540	            }
541	
542	            self._metrics["puts"] += 1
543	            self._metrics["bytes_transferred"] += size
544	
545	            return True, size, metadata
546	
547	        except Exception as e:
548	            self._metrics["errors"] += 1
549	            logger.error(f"RDMA Put failed for {put_key}: {e}", exc_info=True)
550	            return False, 0, None
551	
552	    def _resolve_sender_endpoint(self, sender_rank: int | None = None) -> tuple[str, int] | None:
553	        """Return ``(host, zmq_port)`` for *sender_rank*.
554	
555	        Resolution order:
556	        1. Per-rank registry (``_sender_endpoints[sender_rank]``)
557	        2. Default sender (``sender_host`` / ``sender_zmq_port``)
558	        3. ``None`` if nothing is configured.
559	        """
560	        if sender_rank is not None and sender_rank in self._sender_endpoints:
561	            return self._sender_endpoints[sender_rank]
562	        host = getattr(self, "sender_host", None)
563	        port = getattr(self, "sender_zmq_port", None)
564	        if host and port and str(host).lower() != "auto":
565	            return (host, int(port))
566	        return None

568	    def _query_metadata_at(self, get_key: str, host: str, port: int) -> dict[str, Any] | None:
569	        """Query metadata from a sender endpoint via ZMQ.
570	
571	        Returns ``{source_host, source_port, data_size, is_fast_path}``
572	        or ``None`` when the key is not found / the query fails.
573	        """
574	        zmq_addr = f"tcp://{host}:{port}"
575	        req_socket = self._get_req_socket(zmq_addr, timeout_ms=5000)
576	        try:
577	            req_socket.send(QUERY_INFO + msgspec.msgpack.encode(QueryRequest(request_id=get_key)))
578	            resp = req_socket.recv()
579	            if resp == INFO_NOT_FOUND:
580	                return None
581	            query_resp = msgspec.msgpack.decode(resp, type=QueryResponse)
582	            return {
583	                "source_host": host,
584	                "source_port": port,
585	                "data_size": query_resp.data_size,
586	                "is_fast_path": query_resp.is_fast_path,
587	            }
588	        except Exception as e:
589	            self._invalidate_req_socket(zmq_addr)
590	            logger.debug("Failed to query metadata at %s for %s: %s", zmq_addr, get_key, e)
591	            return None
592	
593	    def _query_metadata_from_sender(self, get_key: str, sender_rank: int | None = None) -> dict[str, Any] | None:
594	        """Query metadata from sender via ZMQ (fallback when ``metadata=None``).
595	
596	        ``get()`` supports three metadata resolution paths::
597	
598	            get(metadata=?)
599	            ├── Path 1: metadata has data_size (adapter path)
600	            │     → use metadata directly → RDMA pull
601	            ├── Path 2: metadata has source_host/port but no data_size
602	            │     → _query_metadata_at(host, port) → get data_size → RDMA pull
603	            └── Path 3: metadata=None (KV-transfer polling path)
604	                  → _query_metadata_from_sender(get_key)   ← this method
605	                  │
606	                  ├── sender endpoint resolved (via update_sender_info)
607	                  │     → ZMQ query → get data_size/is_fast_path
608	                  │     → construct metadata → RDMA pull
609	                  └── sender endpoint unresolved
610	                        → return None → caller retries or times out
611	
612	        When *sender_rank* is provided, the query is routed to that
613	        rank's endpoint (registered via ``update_sender_info(rank=...)``).
614	        Otherwise the default sender is used.
615	        """
616	        endpoint = self._resolve_sender_endpoint(sender_rank)
617	        if endpoint is None:
618	            return None
619	        return self._query_metadata_at(get_key, *endpoint)
620	
621	    def get(
622	        self,
623	        from_stage: str,
624	        to_stage: str,
625	        get_key: str,
626	        metadata: dict[str, Any] | None = None,
627	    ) -> tuple[Any, int] | None:
628	        """Consumer Side.  Allocates from local pool and pulls data via RDMA.
629	
630	        Metadata resolution:
631	
632	        1. ``metadata`` provided **with** ``data_size`` → use directly (RDMA pull).
633	        2. ``metadata`` provided with ``source_host``/``source_port`` but
634	           **without** ``data_size`` → query that specific sender for
635	           ``data_size`` / ``is_fast_path``, then RDMA pull.  This is the
636	           heterogeneous-TP path where the manager knows the target sender
637	           endpoint but not the payload size.
638	        3. ``metadata=None`` → query the default sender (set via
639	           ``update_sender_info()``) for the full metadata.
640	
641	        Returns:
642	            ``(data, size)`` on success, ``None`` on failure.
643	
644	            - **is_fast_path=True** (tensor *or* bytes payload):
645	                Returns ``(ManagedBuffer, size)``.
646	                **CALLER MUST call ``ManagedBuffer.release()`` after consuming.**
647	            - **is_fast_path=False** (serialized Python object):
648	                Returns ``(DeserializedObject, size)``.
649	                Buffer is auto-released internally after deserialization.
650	        """
651	        if self._closed:
652	            raise RuntimeError("Cannot get data: MooncakeTransferEngineConnector is closed")
653	
654	        get_key = self._make_key(get_key, from_stage, to_stage)
655	        _t0 = _time_mod.perf_counter()
656	        metadata = self._resolve_metadata(get_key, metadata)
657	        if not metadata:
658	            return None
659	
660	        _t1 = _time_mod.perf_counter()
661	        query_ms = (_t1 - _t0) * 1000
662	
663	        src_host = metadata.get("source_host")
664	        src_port = metadata.get("source_port")
665	        data_size = int(metadata.get("data_size", 0) or 0)
666	        is_fast_path = bool(metadata.get("is_fast_path", False))
667	        if not src_host or not src_port or str(src_host).lower() == "auto":
668	            logger.error(
669	                f"Invalid metadata for {get_key}: source_host={src_host!r}, "
670	                f"source_port={src_port!r}. Cannot establish RDMA connection."
671	            )
672	            return None
673	
674	        if data_size == 0:
675	            logger.warning(f"Skipping get for {get_key}: data_size is 0 (metadata={metadata})")
676	            return None
677	
678	        try:
679	            recv_buffer, dst_ptr = self._alloc_recv_buffer(data_size, is_fast_path)
680	        except MemoryError:
681	            return None
682	
683	        _t2 = _time_mod.perf_counter()
684	        alloc_ms = (_t2 - _t1) * 1000
685	        try:
686	            resp = self._request_transfer(
687	                get_key=get_key,
688	                source_host=str(src_host),
689	                source_port=int(src_port),
690	                dst_ptr=dst_ptr,
691	                data_size=data_size,
692	            )
693	        except zmq.Again as e:
694	            self._metrics["timeouts"] += 1
695	            logger.error(f"RDMA Get timed out: {e}", exc_info=True)
696	            recv_buffer.release()
697	            return None
698	        except Exception as e:
699	            self._metrics["errors"] += 1
700	            logger.error(f"RDMA transfer request failed: {e}", exc_info=True)
701	            recv_buffer.release()
702	            return None
703	
704	        _t3 = _time_mod.perf_counter()
705	        rdma_ms = (_t3 - _t2) * 1000
706	        if resp != TRANS_DONE:
707	            self._metrics["errors"] += 1
708	            logger.error(f"RDMA Get failed: received {resp} instead of TRANS_DONE")
709	            recv_buffer.release()
710	            return None
711	
712	        try:
713	            sync_ms = self._sync_receive_buffer_if_needed()
714	        except Exception as e:
715	            self._metrics["errors"] += 1
716	            logger.error(f"Failed to synchronize Mooncake receive buffer: {e}", exc_info=True)
717	            recv_buffer.release()
718	            return None
719	
720	        try:
721	            return self._decode_result(
722	                get_key=get_key,
723	                recv_buffer=recv_buffer,
724	                data_size=data_size,
725	                is_fast_path=is_fast_path,
726	                query_ms=query_ms,
727	                alloc_ms=alloc_ms,
728	                rdma_ms=rdma_ms,
729	                sync_ms=sync_ms,
730	                start_time=_t0,
731	            )
732	        except Exception as e:
733	            self._metrics["errors"] += 1
734	            logger.error(f"RDMA result decode failed for {get_key}: {e}", exc_info=True)
735	            return None
736	
737	    def _resolve_metadata(self, get_key: str, metadata: dict[str, Any] | None) -> dict[str, Any] | None:
738	        """Resolve full transfer metadata for a receive request."""
739	        if not metadata:
740	            # Path 3: no metadata at all — query default sender
741	            if not self.sender_host or not self.sender_zmq_port or str(self.sender_host).lower() == "auto":
742	                raise RuntimeError(
743	                    f"get(metadata=None) requires sender info to be resolved, "
744	                    f"but sender_host={self.sender_host!r}, sender_zmq_port={self.sender_zmq_port!r}. "
745	                    f"Call update_sender_info(host, port) before using get() without metadata."
746	                )
747	            return self._query_metadata_from_sender(get_key)
748	
749	        if "data_size" in metadata:
750	            # Path 1: metadata is complete
751	            return metadata
752	
753	        # Path 2: partial metadata (host/port only) — query that sender
754	        partial_host = metadata.get("source_host")
755	        partial_port = metadata.get("source_port")
756	        if not partial_host or not partial_port:
757	            logger.warning(
758	                "get(%s): partial metadata missing source_host/source_port, cannot resolve data_size. metadata=%s",
759	                get_key,
760	                metadata,
761	            )
762	            return None
763	        return self._query_metadata_at(get_key, str(partial_host), int(partial_port))
764	
765	    def _alloc_recv_buffer(self, data_size: int, is_fast_path: bool) -> tuple[ManagedBuffer, int]:
766	        """Allocate the receive-side buffer and return ``(buffer, dst_ptr)``."""
767	        # For non-fast-path serialized objects, allocate a few extra bytes as
768	        # padding. Mooncake's TCP/memcpy transport may prepend a protocol byte.
769	        padding = 4 if not is_fast_path else 0
770	        alloc_size = data_size + padding
771	        try:
772	            offset = self.allocator.alloc(alloc_size)
773	        except MemoryError:
774	            logger.error(f"Failed to allocate {alloc_size} bytes in receive pool")
775	            raise
776	        recv_buffer = ManagedBuffer(self.allocator, offset, alloc_size, self.pool)
777	        return recv_buffer, self.base_ptr + offset
